Can you help us integrate our payroll processes so we have a single source of truth for all employee earnings and payment configurations?

The activity describes a finance team's need to reconcile payroll data, track pay rates against pay bands and job levels, ensure competitive and compliant payment structures, and integrate payroll processes for a single source of truth on employee earnings and payment configurations.

All 8 candidates are focused on engineering changes, product lifecycles, material provisioning, bill-of-materials management, production transitions, and compliance validation. None of them address payroll reconciliation, pay rate management, pay band alignment, compensation structure, or employee earnings integration—which are the core requirements of this HR/Finance-focused activity.

While some candidates mention "HR" in use cases (e.g., workforce readiness, training), they are specifically scoped to production transition capability assessment and workforce skill gaps for manufacturing changes, not payroll and compensation management. The activity requires a payroll or compensation management system, which is not represented in this candidate set.
